content:
{'text': '美國總統當勞・特朗普週二在副總統站在身後的情況下，未有明確表態支持萬斯角逐2028年總統大選。', 'paragraph_context': 'Donald Trump stopped short of giving JD Vance his outright backing for the 2028 presidential election on Tuesday, with the vice president standing right behind him.'}

{'text': '在一個於橢圓形辦公室舉行、宣布新「吹哨人獎勵計劃」的活動上，一名記者向特朗普提問：「既然副總統在場，副總統昨日在一個訪問中表示，他認為如果你決定參選2028年，你會支持他。既然我們都在場，可否告訴我們……」', 'paragraph_context': 'During an Oval Office event announcing a new whistleblower reward program, a reporter asked Trump: “Since we have the vice president here, the vice president said in an interview yesterday that he thought that you would endorse him if he does decide to run in 2028. Since we’re here, could you tell us…”'}

{'text': '該問題提及萬斯接受記者馬克・哈爾珀林的訪問，副總統在訪問中表示他相信特朗普若參選2028年會支持他，不過或許不會即時表態。目前在共和黨提名民調中領先的萬斯亦告訴哈爾珀林，兩人未曾討論過這個議題。', 'paragraph_context': 'The question referred to Vance’s interview with journalist Mark Halperin, in which the vice president said he believed Trump would endorse him if he ran in 2028, although perhaps not immediately. Vance, the current frontrunner in polling on the GOP nomination, also told Halperin the pair had not discussed the subject.'}

{'text': '特朗普在記者未問完前就打斷了他。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump interrupted the reporter before he finished the question.'}

{'text': '「唔，我要同你講，佢係個非常有能力嘅人，亦都係個好好嘅人，但講真話，我唔認為我哋曾經討論過呢件事。」總統談到萬斯時表示。', 'paragraph_context': '“Well, I tell you this, he’s a very talented person and he’s a very good person, but we’ve, literally, I don’t think we’ve ever talked about it,” the president said of Vance.'}

{'text': '萬斯插嘴道：「冇錯，長官，我都係咁講。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Vance chimed in: “No, sir, I said that too.”'}

{'text': '特朗普繼續講，萬斯喺佢身後點頭：「你話，有邊個會信呢？我唔會同佢傾呢件事，佢亦都唔會同我傾呢件事……」', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump continued, as Vance nodded behind him: “You know, who would believe that? I don’t talk about it with him, he doesn’t talk about it…”'}

{'text': '「依家仲好早，真係好早，我哋要先去應付中期選舉，先睇下點。」特朗普補充道。', 'paragraph_context': '“It’s early, very early right now, we have to get through the midterms, see how it goes,” Trump added.'}

{'text': '總統之後話鋒一轉，談到佢最近嘅競選集會，誇耀佢聲稱自己出席活動所帶嚟嘅影響，隨後承認：「喺度企兩個鐘頭不斷鬧人、發洩，真係唔容易。雖然台下有咁多人，但嗰啲場合入面充滿愛。」', 'paragraph_context': 'The president then pivoted to talking about his recent campaign rallies, boasting about the impact he claims his appearances have had before acknowledging: “It’s not easy to stand up there for two hours ranting, raving. You have the crowds, but there’s a lot of love in those rooms.”'}
